notes: Production runtime is Bertina-only and browser endpoints use same-origin /api. Direct-origin checks confirm Bertina MySQL, commerce schema/order capture, SMTP configuration and the account runtime are present. Public TLS currently presents a self-signed certificate while the paid CA certificate is under Bertina validation/issuance, so public auth/email certification and monetary checkout remain fail-closed. Commerce checkout stays disabled until the server-side gateway key, amount contract and fulfilment/booking gates are verified.
